summary.name: Mixxx
summary.one_liner: Mixxx is free, open-source DJ software for mixing digital music files live, with support for DJ controllers and turntables with timecode vinyl.
use_cases: Mixing digital music files in a live DJ set
Finding the next track by BPM and key
Controlling playback with a DJ controller
Scratching digital tracks with timecode vinyl
Adding and chaining sound effects while DJing
Learning to DJ on a laptop
summary.what_it_does: Mixxx provides tools for live DJ mixing with digital music files. It detects BPM and musical key to help find compatible tracks, and its Sync Lock feature matches the tempo and beats of tracks for mixing. It has built-in mappings for DJ controller hardware and a programmable mapping system for any MIDI or HID device. It supports turntables with timecode vinyl for playback control and scratching, including vinyl passthrough mode, and offers chainable audio effects.
notable: Built-in DJ controller mappings plus programmable mapping for any MIDI or HID device
Timecode vinyl control with vinyl passthrough mode
Community-driven with no company behind it
Listed as a top free Mac app on the Mac App Store
caveats: No company behind development; it is volunteer-run, so no commercial support is implied
